title: [Salty's Services, Warehouse]
description: The way through the warehouse dead-ends in a semicircle of shops surrounding a wood-lined marble relief of a thrashing kraken, which faces the path into the area, its many marble tentacles splaying outward from the relief's main body.  Two of the relief's tentacles prominently clutch a silver-bordered driftwood sign.  The entire installation is directly opposite some wide stone benches carved with a starfish motif, where several warehouse merchants and customers take repose.
